title: Across a moist surface
hook: A frog can exchange gases in more than one way.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The arrows show oxygen crossing a simplified moist skin surface toward a blood vessel. Skin can contribute to gas exchange in many amphibians; the drawing does not imply all amphibians breathe only through skin.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: Which part of a frog can contribute to gas exchange when kept moist?

claims.text: A frog can exchange gases in more than one way. Which part of a frog can contribute to gas exchange when kept moist? The arrows show oxygen crossing a simplified moist skin surface toward a blood vessel. Skin can contribute to gas exchange in many amphibians; the drawing does not imply all amphibians breathe only through skin.
